name: Restoring a Narcolepsy run that fell asleep starts with a full fatigue bar
contract: Hardcore - Narcolepsy (170) has one life and a fatigue bar that drains outside rest areas from 100 to 0, one point every 4.2 seconds; at 0 the character falls asleep and dies, which fails the run.
GM tooling with no live reference: .coa trial restore restarts the meters as a new activation does, because a run restored with the fatal value would die again at once.

Expected: outside a rest area a bar set to 3 kills the character within seconds, the restore reports a full bar and resurrects, the bar then reads 100 of 100 and the character is still alive after more than one drain interval.

steps.label: Narcolepsy activates through its native request
Leave the starter rest area for open Elwynn Forest
Set the bar three points from empty
The bar is draining: the character is not in a rest area
The character falls asleep when the bar empties
Restore the run that fell asleep
DISCRIMINATING: the restore reports the meters restarted
steps.text: Hunger and thirst start from zero and the fatigue bar is full.

steps.label: Read the bar after the restore
DISCRIMINATING: the bar is full, not the fatal value
DISCRIMINATING: the restored character does not fall asleep again at once
